scenarios.title: The extension activates without error
scenarios.evidence: activate() resolved and all 5 modkit commands are registered, so the host composition completed inside activation

scenarios.title: A single W3D opens with its descriptor
scenarios.evidence: opened through "Reopen Editor With… → Modkit Asset Preview" with Model/Metadata/Tree stages and a scene of 2 nodes — one per hierarchy pivot, so block 9's "pivots 2" is confirmed. The animation count is not: no stage in this build prints it, so "animations 1" cannot be read from the product surface at all

scenarios.title: A W3D nested in a BIG archive opens as a subject
scenarios.evidence: the archive itself opens, but the extension exposes no command or URI shape that names an entry inside it — «data/editor/molds/bowl.w3d» is unreachable from outside the page, and inside the page the archive stage reads an entry’s bytes into a hex pane rather than opening it as a subject. The host route exists and Electron uses it; this product does not wire it, so nested opening is absent here (wiring missing, blocks 13–14)

scenarios.title: A VXL without its sidecar reports a leak-free diagnostic
scenarios.evidence: the model opened without its sidecar on Model/Tree/Metadata/Hex stages, but the page never showed x3.host/companion-unavailable — in fact it showed no diagnostic of any kind (0 seen), so the code cannot be confirmed and its text cannot be checked for leaked paths
